item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena prepares two balls of dough in her kitchen in Jaipur. She mixes yeast, sugar and warm water into the first ball, but leaves yeast out of the second ball. After one hour, only the first ball of dough has risen.

Why does the dough with yeast rise while the dough without yeast does not rise in the same way?

options.A: The yeast is broken down by the flour and turns into gas.
options.B: The yeast respires, releasing carbon dioxide gas that makes the dough expand.
options.C: The warm water alone produces gas in any dough left for one hour.
options.D: The yeast absorbs air from the kitchen and stores it in the dough.
